title: The Furrows
text: Close up, the furrows are worse. A sine wave cut into the ground, crest to crest four metres exactly, running dead straight for a kilometre. The Burrowers here aren't digging at random. Each one walks its own furrow and tamps the soil down behind it.

lines.text: "Someone ploughed this. A long time ago. And they taught the animals to keep ploughing after they'd gone."

choices.label: Survey the grid
choices.reply: Spacing 4.00 m, error under a centimetre. The interval matches the planting grid in our own farm templates, the ones we haven't used yet.

choices.label: Watch the Burrowers
choices.reply: One Burrower, one furrow, one pass a day. Not hunting. Working.
